editorial:
You follow Woody, an older man who believes a sweepstakes letter means he is rich, and his son David, who reluctantly drives him from Montana to Nebraska. The road trip feels quiet, dry, and funny, with small-town family tension and awkward moments. It is black-and-white, slow, and grounded, so you feel every mile and every stubborn silence.

Bruce Dern and Will Forte make the father-son bond feel real, while June Squibb steals scenes with sharp humor. The pacing is slow, but the payoff comes from small details, not big action. If you want explosions, skip it; if you like character stories, stay. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the end, after the long trip, Woody finally learns the prize letter is just a scam, but David still lets him drive through his old hometown in a new truck so neighbors think he won. Woody gets a moment of pride, then they head home together. The real win is their repaired father-son bond, not the money at all.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character-driven road trips and family stories.
